acquired.ex: She acquired a rare old book at the market.

example.en: The museum acquired three new paintings this year.
example.zh: 博物館今年購得三幅新畫作。

note.meaning: 取得；獲得（通常透過購買或努力）。
note.usage: 比 get/buy 正式，常用被動 be acquired；亦可指習得技能。

noteEn.usage: More formal than 'get'; also used for skills (acquire knowledge).

noteEs.exampleTr: El museo adquirió tres cuadros nuevos este año.
noteEs.meaning: adquirir; obtener, comprando o con esfuerzo.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que get/buy; también para habilidades.

noteHi.exampleTr: संग्रहालय ने इस साल तीन नई पेंटिंग प्राप्त कीं।
noteHi.meaning: प्राप्त करना; खरीदकर या मेहनत से पाना।
noteHi.usage: get/buy से अधिक औपचारिक; कौशल सीखने के लिए भी प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: その美術館は今年、新しい絵画を3点取得した。
noteJa.usage: get/buyより硬い表現。技能の習得にも使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 박물관은 올해 새 그림 세 점을 취득했다.
noteKo.usage: get/buy보다 격식 있는 표현이며 기술 습득에도 쓴다.

also.ex: He speaks French and also a little German.

amenity.en: a useful public place or service
amenity.ex: The town has a new public amenity near the park.
amenity.zh: civic amenity site：公共回收設施

approximately.ex: The trip takes approximately two hours.

asked.ex: The teacher asked us about our weekend.

asks.ex: Mum asks me to tidy my room every day.

average.ex: The average age of the class is twenty.

away.ex: Don't throw away that box; we can use it.

banks.ex: I always carry a power bank when I travel.

batteries.en: things that store and give electric power
batteries.ex: The remote control needs new batteries.

behalf.en: on behalf of: for or representing
behalf.ex: She spoke on behalf of all the workers.

bin.ex: Please put your empty bottle in the bin.

blazes.ex: Firefighters fought the blaze for six hours.

bought.ex: We bought fresh bread this morning.

brought.ex: He brought his old phone to the shop.

buy.ex: I want to buy a new jacket.

buys.ex: That cheap toy was a bad impulse buy.

carried.ex: The tests were carried out last week.

cause.ex: Ice on the road can cause accidents.

cautioned.ex: The doctor cautioned him against eating too much salt.

centre.en: a place for a special activity
centre.ex: There is a sports centre near my school.

charge.ex: Delivery is free of charge for members.

chargers.en: devices that put power into batteries
chargers.ex: I forgot my phone charger at home.

cheap.ex: These shoes were cheap but comfortable.

civic.en: of a town or its people
civic.ex: Voting is an important civic duty.

collection.en: the act of picking things up

compact.en: small and not taking much space
compact.ex: She bought a compact camera for her trip.

compared.en: when you look at both together
compared.ex: Prices are high compared with last year.

comparison.ex: In comparison with London, our town is quiet.

consequently.ex: He missed the bus and consequently was late.

considerable.ex: The project cost a considerable amount of money.

example.en: Learning a language takes considerable effort.
example.zh: 學習一種語言需要相當大的努力。

note.usage: 正式用語，修飾數量、金額、程度等名詞，如 considerable amount / increase。

noteEn.meaning: large in size, amount or degree.
noteEn.usage: Formal; often with amount, increase, cost or effort.

noteEs.exampleTr: Aprender un idioma requiere un esfuerzo considerable.
noteEs.usage: Formal; acompaña a cantidad, aumento, coste.

noteHi.exampleTr: कोई भाषा सीखने में काफ़ी मेहनत लगती है।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द; मात्रा, राशि या वृद्धि के साथ प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: 言語を学ぶにはかなりの努力が必要だ。
noteJa.usage: 量・金額・増加などを表す名詞を修飾する硬い語。

noteKo.exampleTr: 언어를 배우는 데는 상당한 노력이 필요하다.
noteKo.usage: 양·금액·증가 등을 수식하는 격식 있는 단어이다.

consigned.en: put away somewhere to get rid of it
consigned.ex: Old letters were consigned to the attic.

example.en: Many old phones are consigned to drawers and forgotten.
example.zh: 許多舊手機被丟進抽屜後就被遺忘了。

note.meaning: 把……丟棄、送往（不想要的地方）。
note.usage: 常用 consign A to B，如 consign sth to the bin / to history，帶有「打入冷宮」的意味。

noteEn.meaning: to put something somewhere to get rid of it.
noteEn.usage: Use 'consign something to' a place, e.g. to the bin or to history.

noteEs.exampleTr: Muchos teléfonos viejos acaban relegados a cajones y olvidados.
noteEs.meaning: relegar; enviar algo a un lugar no deseado.
noteEs.usage: Se usa consign A to B, p. ej. consign to the bin.

noteHi.exampleTr: कई पुराने फ़ोन दराज़ों में डाल कर भुला दिए जाते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को (अनचाही जगह) डाल देना या भेज देना।
noteHi.usage: consign A to B के रूप में प्रयोग, जैसे consign to the bin।

noteJa.exampleTr: 多くの古い携帯電話は引き出しにしまい込まれ、忘れられる。
noteJa.meaning: （不要な場所へ）追いやる、捨てる。
noteJa.usage: consign A to B の形で使う（例：consign to the bin）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 많은 오래된 휴대폰이 서랍에 처박혀 잊힌다.
noteKo.usage: consign A to B 형태로 쓴다(예: consign to the bin).

consumers.ex: Consumers want cheaper and greener products.

contain.ex: This drink does not contain sugar.

contributing.ex: Traffic is contributing to air pollution.

craze.ex: The new dance became a craze among teenagers.

creating.ex: The new factory is creating many jobs.

devices.en: small machines with a special job
devices.ex: Turn off all devices before the exam.

discarded.ex: Discarded bottles lay on the beach.

disposable.en: made to be thrown away after use

disposed.ex: Please dispose of your rubbish properly.

disproportionately.en: much more than is fair or expected
disproportionately.ex: Poor families are disproportionately affected by price rises.

example.en: Young people are disproportionately affected by high rents.
example.zh: 年輕人受高房租影響的程度不成比例地大。

note.usage: 多修飾動詞或形容詞，如 disproportionately affected / high，表示比應有程度多（或少）。

noteEn.meaning: much more or less than is fair or expected.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los jóvenes se ven desproporcionadamente afectados por los alquileres altos.
noteEs.usage: Suele ir con affected, high, etc.; indica más de lo esperado.

noteHi.exampleTr: युवा लोग ऊँचे किराए से असमान रूप से अधिक प्रभावित होते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: असमान रूप से; अनुपात से अधिक।
noteHi.usage: affected, high आदि के साथ; अपेक्षा से बहुत अधिक दर्शाता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 若者は高い家賃の影響を不釣り合いに大きく受けている。
noteJa.usage: affected や high などと共に、本来より多いことを示す。

noteKo.exampleTr: 젊은이들은 높은 임대료의 영향을 불균형적으로 크게 받는다.
noteKo.usage: affected, high 등과 함께 써서 예상보다 훨씬 많음을 나타낸다.

driving.en: causing something to grow or happen
driving.ex: Young buyers are driving demand for electric cars.

durability.en: ability to last a long time
durability.ex: This bag is known for its durability.

example.en: Customers care more about durability than style.
example.zh: 顧客較重視耐用性而非款式。

note.usage: 不可數名詞，常與 improve / test / greater 連用，形容詞為 durable。

noteEn.meaning: the quality of lasting a long time.

noteEs.exampleTr: A los clientes les importa más la durabilidad que el estilo.
noteEs.usage: Sustantivo incontable; el adjetivo es durable.

noteHi.exampleTr: ग्राहक स्टाइल से अधिक टिकाऊपन की परवाह करते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: टिकाऊपन; लंबे समय तक चलने की क्षमता।
noteHi.usage: अगणनीय संज्ञा; विशेषण रूप durable है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 客はデザインより耐久性を重視している。
noteJa.meaning: 耐久性；長持ちする性質。
noteJa.usage: 不可算名詞。形容詞は durable。

durable.en: able to last a long time
durable.ex: Kids need durable shoes for playing outside.

earphones.en: small speakers worn in the ears
earphones.ex: He listens to music with his earphones on the bus.

easy.ex: This recipe is quick and easy.

electronic.ex: Electronic books are popular with students.

electronics.ex: The store sells electronics at low prices.

emphasised.en: said strongly that something is important
emphasised.ex: The coach emphasised the need for teamwork.

example.en: The teacher emphasised that practice is essential.
example.zh: 老師強調練習是不可或缺的。

note.usage: 英式拼法（美式 emphasize），後接名詞或 that 子句；名詞為 emphasis。

noteEn.meaning: to show or say that something is very important.
noteEn.usage: British spelling (US: emphasize); followed by a noun or 'that'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El profesor enfatizó que la práctica es esencial.
noteEs.usage: Ortografía británica (EE. UU.: emphasize); va con sustantivo o that.

noteHi.exampleTr: शिक्षक ने ज़ोर दिया कि अभ्यास ज़रूरी है।
noteHi.usage: ब्रिटिश वर्तनी (अमेरिकी: emphasize); संज्ञा या that-वाक्य के साथ।

noteJa.exampleTr: 先生は練習が不可欠だと強調した。
noteJa.usage: イギリス綴り（米：emphasize）。名詞か that 節を続ける。

noteKo.usage: 영국식 철자(미국식 emphasize)이며 명사나 that절이 뒤따른다.

encouraged.ex: Parents encouraged their children to read more.

equipment.en: tools and machines for a purpose

estimates.ex: The report estimates that prices will rise.

facilities.ex: The city plans new recycling facilities.

facility.en: a building for a special purpose
facility.ex: The new sports facility opens next month.

fans.en: machines that move air to cool you
fans.ex: Small desk fans are popular in summer.

fast.ex: Fast fashion creates a lot of waste.
fast.zh: fast tech：快時尚科技（便宜速丟的電子產品）

fast-tech.en: cheap tech that is used briefly
fast-tech.ex: He threw away another fast-tech gadget.
fast-tech.zh: 快科技（便宜即丟的電子產品）的

festive.ex: The streets look festive in December.

fires.ex: Dry weather can cause forest fires.

forefront.ex: The company is at the forefront of new technology.
forefront.zh: at the forefront of：走在最前端

forum.en: a group or meeting for discussing issues
forum.ex: The forum meets every year to discuss recycling.

found.ex: The study found that sleep improves memory.

free.ex: Entry to the museum is free.

from.en: showing where someone works or belongs

fuelling.en: making something grow or get stronger
fuelling.ex: Low prices are fuelling demand for new cars.

furthermore.ex: The flat is cheap; furthermore, it is near the station.

gadgets.ex: My uncle loves buying kitchen gadgets.

general.en: normal, not for a special type
general.ex: Put the paper in the general recycling box.
general.zh: 一般的（general bin：一般垃圾桶）

greater.ex: Teachers want greater support from parents.

had.zh: 已經（過去完成式助動詞）

half.ex: Half of the class was absent today.

harbour.ex: Old buildings can harbour dangerous mould.

note.meaning: 藏有；內含（常指隱藏或不易察覺的東西）。
note.usage: 正式用法，主詞多為物品或地方，受詞為危險物、細菌或情感；也可作 harbour doubts（心存疑慮）。

noteEn.meaning: to contain or hold something, often hidden.
noteEn.usage: Formal; used with germs, dangers or feelings, e.g. 'harbour doubts'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las toallas sucias pueden albergar gérmenes.
noteEs.meaning: albergar o contener algo, a menudo oculto.
noteEs.usage: Formal; con gérmenes, peligros o sentimientos: harbour doubts.

noteHi.exampleTr: गंदे तौलियों में कीटाणु छिपे हो सकते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: अंदर छिपाए रखना या समाए रखना।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक शब्द; अक्सर कीटाणु, खतरे या भावनाओं के साथ: harbour doubts।

noteJa.exampleTr: 汚れたタオルには細菌が潜んでいることがある。
noteJa.meaning: （目立たないものを）内に抱える・含む。
noteJa.usage: 硬い表現。細菌・危険物・感情などを目的語に取る（harbour doubts：疑いを抱く）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 더러운 수건에는 세균이 숨어 있을 수 있다.
noteKo.usage: 격식체. 세균·위험물·감정 등을 목적어로 씀 (harbour doubts: 의심을 품다).

have.ja: 持っている；（完了の助動詞）

headphones.en: small speakers you wear over your ears
headphones.ex: I wear headphones on the noisy train.

here.ex: Many tourists come here every summer.

household.en: used in or belonging to a home
household.ex: Keep household cleaning products away from children.
household.zh: 家用的（household bin：家用垃圾桶）

however.ex: It was cold; however, we still went swimming.

implored.ex: He implored his son to drive carefully.

impulse.en: sudden wish to do something without thinking
impulse.ex: I bought the chocolate on impulse.

include.en: have as part of a group

increase.en: a rise in amount or number
increase.ex: There was an increase in rain this month.

indicated.ex: Most students indicated a wish to study abroad.

inexpensive.ex: We found an inexpensive hotel near the beach.

item.ex: Each item in the shop has a price tag.

items.ex: Please check all items before you pay.

july.en: the seventh month of the year

last.ex: We moved to a new flat last year.
last.zh: 上一個；最近的（last year：去年）

lasted.ex: My old phone lasted for six years.

leading.ex: Bad diet is leading to health problems.

least.ex: You should sleep at least seven hours.

life.ex: These batteries have a long life.

lifespan.en: the length of time something lasts
lifespan.ex: Good care can extend a laptop's lifespan.

example.en: Regular cleaning can extend the lifespan of your bike.
example.zh: 定期清潔可以延長腳踏車的使用壽命。

note.usage: 可用於人、動物或物品；常說 a short/long lifespan、extend the lifespan of。

noteEn.meaning: the length of time a person, animal or thing lives or works.
noteEn.usage: Common with 'short', 'long' and 'extend the lifespan of'.

noteEs.exampleTr: La limpieza regular puede alargar la vida útil de tu bicicleta.
noteEs.meaning: vida útil; duración de la vida.
noteEs.usage: Para personas, animales u objetos: short/long lifespan, extend the lifespan.

noteHi.exampleTr: नियमित सफ़ाई से आपकी साइकिल का जीवनकाल बढ़ सकता है।
noteHi.meaning: जीवनकाल; किसी चीज़ के चलने की अवधि।
noteHi.usage: लोगों, जानवरों या वस्तुओं के लिए; short/long lifespan, extend the lifespan।

noteJa.exampleTr: 定期的に掃除すれば自転車の寿命を延ばせる。
noteJa.usage: 人・動物・物に使う。short/long lifespan、extend the lifespan of 〜。

noteKo.exampleTr: 정기적인 청소로 자전거의 수명을 늘릴 수 있다.
noteKo.usage: 사람·동물·물건에 씀. short/long lifespan, extend the lifespan of ~.

lights.ex: We hung colourful lights on the tree.

limited.en: not very much or very long
limited.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.

lithium.en: a light metal used in batteries
lithium.ex: Most phones use a lithium battery.

longer.ex: Good shoes last longer than cheap ones.

lorries.ex: Lorries carry fruit to the markets.

lot.ex: She drinks a lot of water every day.

materials.en: substances that things are made from
materials.ex: These bags are made from recycled materials.

mini.ex: She bought a mini oven for her room.

month.ex: I visit my grandmother once a month.

more.ex: I would pay more for better quality.

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we played football.

new.ex: A new study shows teens sleep less.

normal.ex: Cans should not go in the normal bin.

noted.ex: The teacher noted that homework was late.

number.ex: The number of cars keeps growing.

observed.ex: He observed that the room was very quiet.

old.en: used for a long time; not new
old.ex: Give your old clothes to charity.

on.en: used in phrases like 'on behalf of'
on.zh: 代表（on behalf of：代表）；在…上

once.ex: I have been to Paris once.

out.ex: The police carried out a careful search.

outing.en: one time something is used or taken out
outing.ex: The new tent broke on its first outing.

pay.ex: I will pay for the tickets.

people.ex: Many people walk to work here.

perceived.en: seen or thought of in a certain way
perceived.ex: The new rule was perceived as unfair.

example.en: Cycling is often perceived as a healthy habit.
example.zh: 騎腳踏車常被視為健康的習慣。

note.usage: 常用 perceive A as B 或被動 be perceived as，表示人們對某事的看法。

noteEn.meaning: to see or think of something in a particular way.
noteEn.usage: Often 'perceive A as B' or passive 'be perceived as'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Ir en bicicleta se percibe a menudo como un hábito saludable.
noteEs.meaning: percibir; considerar; ver de cierta manera.
noteEs.usage: Suele usarse perceive A as B o en pasiva: be perceived as.

noteHi.exampleTr: साइकिल चलाना अक्सर एक स्वस्थ आदत माना जाता है।
noteHi.usage: अक्सर perceive A as B या be perceived as के रूप में।

noteJa.exampleTr: 自転車に乗ることは健康的な習慣と見なされることが多い。
noteJa.meaning: 〜と見なす；認識する；知覚する。
noteJa.usage: perceive A as B、受動態 be perceived as 〜 の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 자전거 타기는 흔히 건강한 습관으로 여겨진다.
noteKo.usage: perceive A as B 또는 수동태 be perceived as ~ 형태로 자주 씀.

phenomenon.en: something that happens and is noticed
phenomenon.ex: Online shopping is a global phenomenon.

example.en: Working from home has become a common phenomenon.
example.zh: 在家工作已成為常見的現象。

note.meaning: 現象；（引人注意的）社會趨勢。
note.usage: 可數名詞，複數為 phenomena；常與 social, global, natural 等形容詞連用。

noteEn.meaning: something that happens or exists and is noticed, often a trend.

noteEs.exampleTr: Trabajar desde casa se ha convertido en un fenómeno común.
noteEs.usage: Sustantivo contable; plural phenomena; social/global/natural phenomenon.

noteHi.exampleTr: घर से काम करना एक आम घटना बन गई है।
noteHi.meaning: घटना या प्रवृत्ति जो देखी जाती है।
noteHi.usage: गणनीय संज्ञा; बहुवचन phenomena; social/global phenomenon।

noteJa.exampleTr: 在宅勤務はよくある現象になった。
noteJa.meaning: 現象；注目される社会的傾向。
noteJa.usage: 可算名詞で複数形は phenomena。social / global / natural などと結びつく。

noteKo.usage: 가산명사, 복수형은 phenomena. social/global/natural 등과 함께 씀.

placed.ex: She placed the bottle in the recycling box.

plants.ex: The town has two power plants.

power.ex: My power bank charges my phone twice.
power.ja: 電源（power bank：モバイルバッテリー）

preceding.ex: Sales rose compared with the preceding month.

example.en: Profits were higher than in the preceding year.

note.meaning: 在前的；之前的（時間或順序上緊接在前）。
note.usage: 多置於名詞前作形容詞，如 the preceding year/month/chapter；比 previous 更正式。

noteEn.meaning: coming just before in time or order.
noteEn.usage: Used before a noun, e.g. 'the preceding year'; more formal than 'previous'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los beneficios fueron mayores que en el año anterior.
noteEs.usage: Antes del sustantivo: the preceding year; más formal que previous.

noteHi.exampleTr: मुनाफ़ा पिछले साल की तुलना में अधिक था।
noteHi.usage: संज्ञा से पहले: the preceding year; previous से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 利益は前年より多かった。
noteJa.usage: 名詞の前に置く（the preceding year）。previous より硬い表現。

noteKo.usage: 명사 앞에 씀 (the preceding year). previous보다 격식 있는 표현.

premium.ex: People pay a premium for organic food.

previous.ex: Prices were lower in the previous year.

product.ex: This product is made in Japan.

proportion.ex: A large proportion of students live nearby.

example.en: A small proportion of visitors come by train.
example.zh: 一小部分遊客是搭火車來的。

note.usage: 常用 a large/small/substantial proportion of + 名詞；in proportion to 表示「與…成比例」。

noteEn.meaning: a part or share of a whole.

noteEs.exampleTr: Una pequeña proporción de visitantes llega en tren.
noteEs.usage: a large/small proportion of + sustantivo; in proportion to = en proporción a.

noteHi.exampleTr: थोड़े से पर्यटक ट्रेन से आते हैं।
noteHi.usage: a large/small proportion of + संज्ञा; in proportion to = के अनुपात में।

noteJa.exampleTr: 電車で来る観光客はごく一部だ。
noteJa.usage: a large / small proportion of + 名詞。in proportion to 〜 で「〜に比例して」。

noteKo.usage: a large/small proportion of + 명사. in proportion to ~: ~에 비례하여.

public.ex: The museum is open to the public.

purchases.ex: Keep receipts for all your purchases.

put.ex: Put your coat on the chair.

puts.ex: The report puts the cost at two million euros.

recent.ex: A recent study found students sleep less.

paragraphs: Many people in Ireland buy cheap, small electronic things. A new survey says this makes more electronic waste. People call these things "fast tech". Some examples are mini fans, Christmas lights, headphones and phone chargers.
The survey asked people in 12 countries in Europe. In Ireland, 89% of people bought fast tech last year. Irish people bought 91 million of these things.

Many people do not use these things for long. 44% of Irish people threw one away very quickly. A lot of people put them in the normal bin. But most people say they will pay more for things that last longer.

Elizabeth O'Reilly works for WEEE Ireland. She says people throw these things away because they are cheap. But they have useful materials inside. Some have batteries that can start fires in bin lorries. She asks people to repair or recycle old devices. It is free.

Irish shoppers buy a lot of cheap, small electronic products, and this is creating more electronic waste, a new survey says. People call these products "fast tech". They include mini fans, Christmas lights, wireless headphones and phone chargers.

The survey asked people in 12 European countries. In Ireland, 89% of people bought fast tech in the last year. The average in all the countries was 78%. Another study says Irish people bought 91 million of these items last year.

Many items are not used for long. 44% of Irish people threw away a fast-tech product without using it, after using it once, or within a month. A third put at least one item in the normal bin, and fewer than half took items to a recycling centre. But 83% said they would pay more for products that last longer.

Elizabeth O'Reilly from WEEE Ireland says people think these products are disposable because they are cheap and easy to replace. She says they contain materials that should be saved and used again. Many also have lithium batteries, which can start fires in bin lorries if people put them in the household bin. She asks people to repair, reuse or recycle their old devices for free.

Irish consumers are driving a "fast tech" trend that is leading to a rise in discarded electronics, according to a new European survey. Fast tech means cheap, small devices such as mini fans, festive lights, wireless headphones, speakers and power banks.

The survey, carried out in July across 12 European countries for the WEEE Forum, found that 89% of Irish people had bought fast tech in the previous year, compared with an average of 78%. Separate research by WEEE Ireland estimates that Irish consumers bought 91 million such items last year.

Many of these products have a short life. Some 44% of Irish respondents had thrown away a fast-tech item unused, after one use, or within a month. A third had put at least one in the general bin, while fewer than half had brought items to a recycling centre. However, 83% said they would pay more if products lasted longer.

Elizabeth O'Reilly of WEEE Ireland said such items are often treated as disposable because they are cheap impulse buys. She warned that many contain valuable materials, as well as lithium batteries that can cause fires in bin trucks and recycling plants. She urged people to repair or reuse devices and to recycle them free of charge at retailers and civic amenity sites.

The survey, conducted in July across 12 European countries on behalf of the WEEE Forum, found that 89% of Irish people had snapped up fast tech in the preceding year, well above the average of 78%. Separate research by WEEE Ireland puts the number of such items bought here last year at a staggering 91 million.

Many of these gadgets are short-lived. Some 44% of Irish respondents had discarded one unused, after a single outing, or within a month. A third had consigned at least one to the general bin, while fewer than half had taken items to a recycling centre. Tellingly, 83% would willingly pay a premium for more durable products.

Elizabeth O'Reilly of WEEE Ireland observed that such items tend to be regarded as throwaway because they are cheap impulse purchases. She cautioned that they harbour recoverable materials, as well as lithium batteries that can spark blazes in bin trucks and recycling facilities. She implored consumers to repair or repurpose their devices and to recycle them free of charge at retailers and civic amenity sites.
